summary: Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for May 28, 2026. The meeting will consider a 16-for-1 share consolidation and an authorized share capital increase from $50,000 to $80 million, creating 45 billion Class A ordinary shares. These proposals are routine capital structure adjustments, not a special situation. The filing is a standard notice of meeting with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special event disclosed. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics are present.
